decisions.reason: As a GIS solution platform it sits closest to the firm's established programming and geospatial consultancy knowledge base, so the firm can keep improving and commercialising it with relatively low uncertainty.

Mobile field data capture is strongly related to the firm's GIS application capabilities and likely benefits from customer feedback and reuse across projects, though ongoing mobile maintenance makes it somewhat riskier than the core platform.
The 2019 version update shows active learning and development, but as a narrower search extension it is more exposed to being folded into other offerings or dropped if demand is not broad enough.
